scope: Every PNG file listed in the embedded package manifest of PF/PM BETA 0.1.2, including sidecar and payload copies. Repeated file bytes share one image record. Does not enumerate untouched base-game resources or assert coverage of all native resource records.
verification: Release ZIP hashes and embedded manifests were checked against the public release manifests. All 2,861 package PNG hashes match their embedded manifests. Image provenance is established by recorded candidate hashes, byte/RGBA identity, explicit inheritance, native-image authority, or the individually described bounded colour conversions. This is not a new visual review, game runtime test or complete historical rendering replay.

limits.detail: Historical Windows font filenames establish the face used. Where the old record lacks a font hash or TTC index, catalog metadata identifies the inspected current file, not proven historical bytes.

One sound-only tutorial retains the old countdown lettering. Its Noto Sans face is traced through the historical countdown profile and composition command; that older timer layout was not pixel-replayed.
An empty font_ids list means original glyph reuse or recorded generated lettering, as specified by the binding method. It does not identify a model output with a commercial or open-source font.
This register publishes source filenames, record pointers, digests and use relationships. Maintainer-held authoring records, private conversations, game artwork and font binaries are not attached.
